system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual

See also: General Equipment, Sith Alchemy Talent Tree

Several artifacts of great power and significance were created in the time of ancient Sith Lords. Though most Sith of the modern eras tend to eschew the arcane and esoteric knowledge used to create these artifacts, remnants of these dark objects still lie undiscovered in forgotten tombs across the galaxy. Sith Artifacts are considered priceless; thus, they have no costs associated with them.

SITH ARTIFACT DESCRIPTION
Jedi Academy Training Manual
Sith Amulet Ancient relics of the Great Hyperspace War and other conflicts between the Jedi and Sith of the Old Republic, Sith Amulets are weapons of The Dark Side.
Sith Poison A favorite of The Krath and of The Mecrosa Order, Sith Poison is the most insidious of inventions.
Sith Scrolls and Tomes Locked away in the mausoleums dedicated to ancient Sith Lords are thousands of records bearing instructions on how to master a variety of Sith techniques.
Sith Talismans A Sith Talisman enhances its wearer's Force attacks. When Jedi first discover Sith Talismans, they find the trinkets can be made to serve the Light without adverse consequences.
The Muur Talisman One of the most dangerous artifacts of The Dark Side known to have surfaced is The Muur Talisman.
Scum and Villainy
The Fell Star The Fell Star is a powerful Force artifact. Some legends reveal that The Fell Star was a Sith talisman, but even these tales cannot be verified.
Legacy Era Campaign Guide
Darth Krayt's Holocron There is a secret known only to two individuals in the galaxy that could prove to be the catalyst for great change: Darth Krayt, Emperor of the galaxy and ruler of The Sith, is dying.
Unknown Regions
The Mask of Darth Nihilus This Sith Artifact encourages the wearer to slowly destroy him- or herself for greater power.
Web Enhancements
Darth Revan's Battle Armor Darth Revan's unique Armor provides better protection than the average Light Armor thanks to ancient Rakata technology.
General Homebrew Content
Darth Andeddu's Holocron This ancient Sith Holocron was locked away in Darth Andeddu's tomb on Korriban until it was retrieved by Quinlan Vos at the behest of Count Dooku.
Sith Mask Used by some Sith during The Jedi Civil War, this mask blocks outside mental influence and other sensory noise.
Sith Torture Mask These ancient masks were created by The Sith to both assist in torture, as well as serve as a form of torture itself.
